Definition: to drop or strip; by implication, to plunder
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Qal) to draw out; 2) to spoil, plunder, take spoil; 2a) (Qal) to spoil, plunder; 2b) (Hithpolel) to be spoiled, be plundered
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
